en: ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーデ ス テ ィ ニ ー ガ ン ダ ム S p e c Ⅱ が 最 終 決 戦 イ メ ー ジ カ ラ ー で 登 場 ！ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

The "Destiny Gundam Spec II" that appears in "Mobile Suit GundamSEED FREEDOM" is expressed in a molded color that resembles the red glow of its joints during the final battle. A new foil Seal and a prototype Type 35 modified railgun have also been added, allowing you to recreate powerful scenes from the play.

- The state in which the joints emit red light during the final battle in the play is expressed in molded color - A prototype Type 35 modified rail gun is included to allow high-quality reproduction of the scenes in the play.

Accessories Armed: Arondite Beam Sword / High Energy Long Range Beam Cannon / Seal / Beam Seal / High Energy Beam Rifle / Beam Boomerang x 2 / Prototype Type 35 Modified Railgun Accessories: Wings of Light x 1 / Effect Parts for Palma Fiocina / Foil Seal
